QuestInfo.name: Jump, Jump, Jump
QuestInfo.0: Mai says she has a gift for you, somewhere way up high!
QuestInfo.1: Use the #i3800572# platform to get up high and attack a #i3800571# to get your #b#t4033915##k. Bring #i4033915##b#t4033915# x 1#k to Mai.

0.0: You've been so nice chatting with me when you're obviously destined to be some sort of mega-hero that I felt obligated to get you a present.
0.1: It'll take everything you've got to successfully retrieve it, though! I put a box #i3800571# way up high. Destroy it with attacks to get the #b#t4033915##k, then return to me, okay?

yes.0: For a little extra boost, try jumping from a #i3800572#. Use ladders and platforms to your advantage, too.

no.0: But... But... I got it just for you!

1.0: Watching you in action is like watching poetry in motion. I swear, meeting you has changed my life for the better. Here... *sniff* *sniff* let me unlock that box for you.

yes.0: Go on. Open it up. It's the least I can do.
